cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?
